task: Classify tumor type in breast carcinoma. Classes: infiltrating ductal carcinoma, infiltrating lobular carcinoma, and special type. Key H&E clues include duct-forming cohesive nests for ductal carcinoma, discohesive single-file infiltration for lobular carcinoma, and distinctive subtype-specific patterns for special-type tumors.

classes.0: Infiltrating ductal carcinoma with cohesive malignant epithelial nests, tubule formation, and variable desmoplastic stroma.
classes.1: Infiltrating lobular carcinoma with discohesive cells, single-file infiltration, and often low-cohesion growth lacking well-formed ducts.
classes.2: Special-type breast carcinoma showing a distinctive histologic pattern that differs from conventional ductal and lobular morphology.
